description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for managing agent flow execution, including variable resolution, dependency analysis, and database interactions within a workflow system. It references external modules, database entities, and components specific to a flow-based AI or automation platform.

classes.name: IWaitingNode
classes.description: Represents a node's waiting state, including received inputs, expected inputs, and conditional groups.

classes.name: INodeQueue
classes.description: Represents a queued node with its data and inputs for processing.

classes.name: IProcessNodeOutputsParams
classes.description: Parameters for processing node outputs, including graph structure, nodes, edges, and execution context.

classes.name: IAgentFlowRuntime
classes.description: Runtime context for agent flow, including state, chat history, and form data.

classes.name: IExecuteNodeParams
classes.description: Parameters required to execute a node within the flow, including node details, context, and environment.

classes.name: IExecuteAgentFlowParams
classes.description: Parameters for executing an agent flow, extending flow parameters with incoming input.

methods.name: addExecution
methods.description: Creates and saves a new execution record in the database with the current flow state.

methods.name: updateExecution
methods.description: Updates an existing execution record in the database with new data or status.

methods.name: resolveVariables
methods.description: Resolves variables within node data, replacing placeholders with actual values from context, chat history, or external variables.

methods.name: getNodeInputConnections
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts input connections for a specific node based on workflow edges.

methods.name: setupNodeDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes incoming edges to determine expected inputs and conditional groups for a node.

methods.name: findConditionParent
methods.description: Finds the parent condition node for a given node, if any, by traversing edges.

methods.name: hasReceivedRequiredInputs
methods.description: Checks if a node has received all required and conditional inputs.

methods.name: determineNodesToIgnore
methods.description: Determines which nodes should be ignored based on the evaluation of conditions in decision nodes.

methods.name: processNodeOutputs
methods.description: Handles processing of node outputs, including branching, conditional logic, and updating execution state.

methods.name: processNodeOutputs
methods.description: Processes outputs from a node, manages branching, recursion, and updates execution queue and state.

methods.name: combineNodeInputs
methods.description: Combines multiple node inputs into a single structured object, merging JSON, text, binary, and error data.

methods.name: executeNode
methods.description: Executes a single node in the workflow, handling variable resolution, human input, recursion, and streaming.

methods.name: checkForMultipleStartNodes
methods.description: Validates starting nodes, ensuring only one start node unless in recursive mode.

methods.name: parseFormStringToJson
methods.description: Parses a form string into a JSON object with key-value pairs.

methods.name: executeAgentFlow
methods.description: Main function to traverse and execute the entire agent flow graph, managing state, dependencies, recursion, and external integrations.
